Specification: This module specifies a one-variable transition system in which x starts at 0, can move nondeterministically from 0 to either 1 or 2, and from any nonzero value returns to 0. The main specification is an initial condition together with the temporal formula [][Next]_x and a weak fairness condition WF_x(Next), so the behavior is constrained by stuttering-closed next-state evolution plus fairness for Next. The file also states temporal properties about eventually stabilizing away from 1 or 2, eventual repeated return to zero, the negation of one temporal property, and a postcondition that checks a TLC-generated counterexample trace encoded as records, tuples, and sets.
